regions.today: Any mist and fog will burn off early this morning leaving a mostly bright day with sunny spells, turning hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees, with light to moderate easterly breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry with cloud increasing from the south overnight. Lowest temperatures of4 to 8 degrees in light to moderate easterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: A little uncertainty but Tuesday will start off cloudy with outbreaks of rain and drizzle spreading from the south which will extend northwards throughout the day. Cool with highest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees. Light to moderate easterly winds, fresher on the coast.
